lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four to five observable horizontal rows, spanning the region posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a structured lattice or checkerboard-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent, linear horizontal feature located on the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-reflective pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-cast boundary on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A high-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs situated across the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a uniform spatial arrangement without distinct clustering.
